name: Patient Hub Services
one_liner: US-style hub: benefits investigation, prior authorization, co-pay, specialty pharmacy triage and case management.
fits_when: prescriber offices send enrollment forms and prescriptions to a hub by fax, e-referral or a portal
reimbursement specialists verify each patient's benefits with the payer and run prior authorizations and appeals
commercially insured patients are enrolled in a co-pay program, others screened for free drug or foundation support
each patient is triaged to a specialty pharmacy in the payer's network for first fill
case managers own a case from referral to therapy and keep the office and patient updated
HCP offices and specialty pharmacies may only see their own patients and referrals
gives_you: Referral intake with a review queue, missing-information loop and conversion to a hub case
Hub case lifecycle from intake through benefits, prior auth, access secured, SP triage and on therapy, with a case 360 page
Benefits investigations per payer with coverage outcome, PA requirement and patient cost share
Prior authorizations with submission, payer information requests, approval, denial and appeal
Co-pay enrollment with eligibility screening and expiry, and specialty pharmacy referrals with sign-off, acceptance and first-fill shipment
Row-level access so HCP offices and specialty pharmacies see only their own cases and referrals

catalogue.description: A patient hub for a specialty brand. HCP offices refer patients, case managers open a hub case, reimbursement specialists verify benefits and secure prior authorization, case managers enroll patients in co-pay support and triage them to a specialty pharmacy, and the pharmacy confirms the first fill. Every step is tracked on one case with SLAs, outreach and documents.

roles.name: Case manager
roles.description: Owns each patient's case from referral to therapy: reviews referrals, enrolls co-pay support, triages to a specialty pharmacy and keeps the patient and office informed

roles.name: Reimbursement specialist
roles.description: Runs benefits investigations with payers and submits, follows up and appeals prior authorizations

roles.name: Specialty pharmacy
roles.description: Sees only referrals triaged to it, accepts or declines them and confirms the first-fill shipment

roles.name: HCP office
roles.description: Submits referrals and tracks the status of its own patients' cases

workflows.name: Referral intake
workflows.description: Receive, review, request missing information, then accept into a hub case or reject

workflows.name: Benefits investigation
workflows.description: Verify coverage, PA requirement and cost share with the patient's payer

workflows.name: Prior authorization
workflows.description: Submit, answer payer information requests, approve or deny, and appeal denials

workflows.name: Co-pay enrollment
workflows.description: Screen eligibility, enroll the patient in the co-pay program and track expiry

workflows.name: SP triage
workflows.description: Sign off the referral to an in-network specialty pharmacy, which accepts and ships the first fill

compliance: HIPAA: patient health information is minimum-necessary and scoped by role; HCP offices and pharmacies see only their own patients
HIPAA authorization on file before any payer contact or patient outreach
Patient consent recorded per channel before SMS or WhatsApp messages
Anti-kickback safeguards: co-pay support excludes government-insured patients
Audit trail of every transition, edit and message on the case
catalogue.app_prompt_prefill: A hub for our self-injectable dermatology biologic. About 300 prescriber offices send referrals by fax, e-referral or the HCP portal; reimbursement specialists run the benefits investigation and prior authorization, with appeals. Case managers enroll commercial patients in the co-pay card, screen the rest for free drug, and start a bridge supply when access is delayed. A supervisor signs off every specialty pharmacy triage across our two limited-distribution pharmacies, and patients get SMS and WhatsApp updates at each step.
